incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: latency.slo.breach (p99 512ms > SLO 400ms) — Incident ID: rdw-2026-03-16-41
jordan: Acked. I'm on it. hitting dashboards now.
maria: saw the spike, tracing hot path to encoder pool. Queue depth up on enc-gpu-03.
jordan: confirmed enc-gpu-03 p99 token latency 620ms, CPU steal high. Rolling pin to fallback pool.
sam: I'm scaling encoder pool and draining enc-gpu-03 (evicting batches). ETA 60s.
lee: FYI customer-facing SLO alert page opened, no reported customer errors so far.
pat: Can we enable circuit breaker for large-batch route? Suggest set max_batch_size=8 temporarily.
jordan: doing: apply config -> /deploys/quick/enc-cb-set.sh
jordan: ```
kubectl set env deployment/enc-sidecar CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MAX_BATCH=8
kubectl rollout restart deployment/enc-sidecar
```
maria: scaling finished, warmup to fallback pool looks good. p95 back to 180ms, p99 390ms and dropping.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert status: acknowledged by jordan at 4150002235
sam: holding on manual rollback. monitoring for 5m before close.
lee: tagging incident with potential root cause: hotspot on enc-gpu-03, scheduler imbalance.
jordan: will follow up with retrospective. For now closing page when stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved at 4150002390 — SLOs restored.
